answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities. An agent buys one work slot by locking a 40-unit deposit in the vault; it is burned, not refunded, and carved on a marble ledger for 20 epochs. A verifier checks the slot before work. Forging 100 identities burns 100 x 40 = 4,000 units against 30 per epoch, so the attacker's profit falls to its nadir and never breaks even. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards for 20 epochs.
